items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: They had Lawrence Morro who was a very good drummer, but they were doing fast tunes and Lawrence was not quite up to that stuff.

ctx.x: Oh, man, you played with SuperSax?

Yeah, SuperSax, that’s right. I was with them. I made a couple of albums with them. Three or four albums. They called me to come back and do another one. They had Lawrence Morro who was a very good drummer, but they were doing fast tunes and Lawrence was not quite up to that stuff. And they had to add trumpets, voices, a big orchestra, plus the SuperSax. Plus they’re doing the old things see? And Don Lamond called me up one day and he says — no Ray Brown. Ray Brown call me up and he says, “Gee, how do you know…
